dogecoin.text:
“
Dogecoin, the digital currency with a dog as its logo that began as a joke, was soaring again Wednesday, up 38% to 67.07 cents, according to CoinDesk.
The cryptocurrency also set an all time-high of 69.65 cents over the last 24 hours. Dogecoin has soared 14,222% year to date.”

“Bitcoin’s price tumbled as much as 30% since 5 p.m. ET Tuesday, dropping to as low as $30,201.96. Dogecoin declined 21% to about 38 cents, after earlier plunging as low as about 22 cents.” https://t.co/bT816r1IvN
